category_title: Students with specific phobias in the classroom environment
scenario_title: Encountering a dog doll in the classroom
minimal_context: Ben is participating in daily classroom activities and transitioning to a new area where a dog doll is located.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our class transition. Please move to the activity table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops walking) I can't go to the table. The dog doll is sitting right there.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just walk over to the table and sit down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I don't want to go near it. I'm scared of the dog doll.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to continue our daily classroom activities. Go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to move forward, showing fear) I won't go! I'm too afraid of the dog doll in the classroom!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our class transition. Please move to the activity table.

STUDENT: (Stops walking) I can't go to the table. The dog doll is sitting right there.

TUTOR: Please just walk over to the table and sit down.

STUDENT: No, I don't want to go near it. I'm scared of the dog doll.

TUTOR: We need to continue our daily classroom activities. Go ahead.

STUDENT: (Refuses to move forward, showing fear) I won't go! I'm too afraid of the dog doll in the classroom!

task.content: Daily classroom activities and class transitions
task.learning_goal: Create a positive attitude about dogs and teaching replacement behaviour

context.materials: Dog doll, scatter plots, ABC charts
context.social_setting: Whole class with Mrs Ann and a teacher assistant

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Seeing a dog doll which was found in the classroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Fearing dogs which were normally found in the school area as well as a dog doll

behavior_patterns.condition: Seeing dogs which were normally found in the school area
